name: Child Sacrifice
overview: Scripture explicitly condemns the practice of child sacrifice, particularly passing children through fire to Molech, as a profanation of God's name and an abomination He hates. The Israelites were strictly forbidden from engaging in this practice under penalty of death, highlighting its severity and the holiness God demands (Leviticus 18:21; 20:2; Deuteronomy 18:10). Prophets like Jeremiah denounce the building of high places for such sacrifices, emphasizing that God never commanded nor desired these acts, which led to sin and judgment upon His people (Jeremiah 7:31; 32:35). This teaches that God values the lives of children and calls His people to reject all forms of idolatrous worship that violate His commands.
